chose: The opening's questions join the week's one line of steps and its bundle as items named opening:<n>, a step kind "opening" whose `ticket` field holds that item, rather than widening FlowStep to a union. A ticket's id is capitals, digits and a dash, so it never reads as one; the marks the phone already keeps take the new step with one more enum value and no new store; and the take's ref, <week>:opening:<n>, is the line the bundle already makes from week and item, which home reads from epoch 25.
options: opening:<n> as the step's and item's key, step kind "opening"
FlowStep as a union of a ticket's step and an opening's question
a separate pager before the flow, outside its line
gray: The handover on #3269 leaned to a union as clearer; the reserved key keeps one store and one line. Either shows the owner the same pages.
undo: Make FlowStep a union { kind: "ticket" … } | { kind: "opening", n }, keep reading marks stored with ticket opening:<n>, and give weekItems' opening items their own type.
